author: TeIq
content:
LLM-5 dispatcher landed in commit ba9a1066 (feat(llm): recommend dispatcher state machine (#242)).

Files (counts after fmt):
- polaris-backend/src/llm/recommend_dispatcher.rs — 1267 lines (state machine + 8 unit tests)
- polaris-backend/src/llm/safety_floors.rs — 130 lines (STUB for #235)
- polaris-backend/src/api/llm/case_endpoint.rs — 192 lines (POST handler + DTO + error mapper)
- polaris-backend/src/api/llm/mod.rs — 12 lines
- polaris-backend/tests/llm_dispatcher_e2e.rs — 596 lines (5 integration tests)
- Modified: polaris-backend/src/llm/mod.rs (+2), polaris-backend/src/api/mod.rs (+10), polaris-backend/src/api/state.rs (+41)

State machine flow: trigger gates -> hydrate (LLM-4) -> autonomy short-circuit -> classifier.recommend (LLM-2) -> persist LlmRecommendation observation (LLM-3) -> per RecommendedAction: safety_floors::evaluate -> route Manual/Assisted/Autonomous. Autonomous path inserts the action with actor_kind='autonomous_agent' + full LlmAuditFields envelope (REQ-F1), writes citations, emits to atproto via the existing labeler.

safety_floors stub call sites for the #235 contributor: there is exactly one — polaris-backend/src/llm/recommend_dispatcher.rs::RecommendDispatcher::route_recommended_action calls safety_floors::evaluate(...). The signature already plumbs every input REQ-S1..S8 need (policy identifier+version, action kind, confidence, subject id, pool); #235 only needs to flesh out the body of polaris-backend/src/llm/safety_floors.rs::evaluate. Both files carry pointer comments to #235.

Verification (DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5439/polaris):
- cargo build -p polaris-backend — clean.
- cargo clippy -p polaris-backend --all-targets -- -D warnings — clean.
- cargo fmt --all --check — clean.
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --test llm_dispatcher_e2e — 5/5 pass.
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib llm:: — 14/14 pass.
- Adjacent tests (case_context_hydrate, classifier_recommend_roundtrip, llm_recommendation_observation) still pass.

Coverage gap documented: until safety_floors lands the real impl (#235), the assisted-mode draft branch is not reachable end-to-end (the stub always returns Autonomous). Routing helpers are unit-tested. Tests file documents the regression to add once #235 lands.
